title: diff
description: A diff as git diff writes it, or lines of one, in the dark of code: lines added (+) green, removed (-) red, under its file, the counts of both and its language. A button over it copies the diff as written

lang.description: The language, shown at the right above the diff

file.description: The file the diff is of, shown above it

text.description: The diff, as it is; a line keeps its +, - or space
